description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory’s IM3 project packages raw US inputs for the Total Electricity Loads model. Zenodo lists a public 1.46 GB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The provider identifies EIA-930 hourly demand from 68 balancing authorities, EIA-861 annual power-sector characteristics, county and state population estimates, and county and state boundary shapefiles. The linked TELL Python repository is BSD-2-Clause and uses these materials to train and project weather-sensitive hourly electricity demand. The package can support replication or recalibration of national electricity-load simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this TELL-specific bundle. A limitation is that it combines upstream EIA and geographic products whose source dates and rights require separate review. The landing page does not state years, missing intervals or shapefile version for each component. The ZIP was not downloaded; EIA totals, geographic keys and model-fit statistics were not independently checked.
